trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. From the deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified** — checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failure and the rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0.
